h1: Window cleaning in Barton Creek Preserve
intro: Barton Creek Preserve is a handful of acreage estates entered through the Spanish Oaks gate, on lots of 3 to 12 acres. CleanzATX cleans glass for custom homes here, with a drive that planned around distance and gates.

sections.h2: What Barton Creek Preserve homes are like
paragraphs: The row describes 3 to 12 acre lots with custom homes, priced about $2M to $6M, and access through the Spanish Oaks gate. That is a very different setting from a tight subdivision. Houses sit far from the road and from each other, often at the end of a long drive, with views across open cedar and oak country.

No HOA is listed for this one, so details such as access and timing are agreed between you and us directly. Owners tend to know the property well and want to be told exactly when the crew will arrive.

Acreage means open exposure. Wind carries dust and pollen straight onto the glass, and in a dry stretch the limestone dust off gravel drives and nearby construction coats every pane. Cedar pollen from December to February is heavy on land like this, and live oak pollen follows in March and April.

Well water and irrigation lines for larger landscapes can leave hard water spots that build up on lower panes. If your glass has a cloudy film that normal cleaning does not touch, that is mineral deposit, and we treat it at $10 per pane.

sections.h2: How we work Barton Creek Preserve
paragraphs: We arrange the Spanish Oaks gate with you ahead of time, then drive the long way in with a full truck of water so we are not running back and forth. A large custom home often has stone or stucco that benefits from a soft wash, and pool decks and patios are cleaned by hand so they do not flood. One visit can cover all of it.

A 5,000 square foot house is about $500 for outside glass at the $0.10 per sq ft rate. Exterior time is about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so a house that size is a good half day, with interior glass extra.

why: Long drives and gated access are planned before we load the truck.
Full water on board means no hookup needed on a large property.
Hard water film on lower panes is removed, not just rinsed.
One visit can cover windows, stone soft wash and pool deck.

faq.q: How does the Spanish Oaks gate work for your crew?
faq.a: The Preserve is entered through the Spanish Oaks gate. Send us the code or the name to call and we arrange it before the visit so there is no waiting at the entry.

faq.q: Do you need a hose hookup at my house?
faq.a: No. We carry 200 gallons of water on board and run a pure water system for windows, so we are not tied to your spigot. That helps on large lots with long drives.

faq.q: What would a big acreage home cost?
faq.a: Outside glass is $10 per window or about $0.10 per sq ft, so 5,000 square feet lands near $500. Both sides is $15 per window. Send your address by text and we quote it.

faq.q: Can you wash stone and stucco as well?
faq.a: Yes. Our 12V soft wash system starts at $0.20 per sq ft with a $400 minimum. Limestone is never pressure washed, only soft washed, so the surface is not damaged.

faq.q: How often should acreage glass be cleaned?
faq.a: Most homes in open country do well on Triannual or Quarterly, which saves 15%. It keeps pollen and dust from building up, and it includes a yearly free screen cleaning.
